title: What If We Dimmed the Sun to Cool the Planet?

scenes.text: What if we dimmed the Sun on purpose? One volcano already showed it works.
In 1991, Mount Pinatubo erupted. Stratospheric aerosols rose to more than twenty times their normal level.
Global temperatures fell about half a degree Celsius, and the cooling lasted through 1992.
But the same haze of sulfuric acid also increased ozone depletion.
Scientists have studied copying it by spraying aerosols high in the atmosphere. It would only mask warming, not fix it.
So it would cool the planet like a volcano did, with side effects we would have to keep paying for.
